title: Lost in Implicit Routing: How LLM Agents Fail to Load Relevant Skills at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2610.18522v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reusable skills let LLM agents load task-specific instructions on demand, but they make execution depend on implicit routing over skill metadata. We test whether this design scales by holding SkillsBench tasks and their golden skills fixed while adding irrelevant skills. We find skill routing collapse: agents increasingly load fewer or no skills, even though the relevant skills remain available. With 1,000 irrelevant skills, loaded-skill recall falls from 73.6% to 27.4% and the zero-load rate rises from 9.3% to 51.6%, whereas explicit selection from the same library retains 73.9% recall. Loading other skills, including plausible alternatives to golden skills, is too rare to explain this decline. Masking only the descriptions of irrelevant skills largely restores skill loading, yet with the metadata intact, explicitly asking agents to plan skill use still yields lower recall than preselection. These findings point to semantic interference

translated_title: 迷失于隐式路由：LLM智能体为何在大规模场景下无法加载相关技能
translated_abstract: 可复用技能使LLM智能体能够按需加载任务特定的指令，但这使得执行过程依赖于基于技能元数据的隐式路由。我们通过固定SkillsBench任务及其黄金技能、同时添加无关技能的方式，测试这种设计是否具有可扩展性。我们发现了“技能路由崩溃”现象：即使相关技能仍然可用，智能体加载的技能却越来越少甚至完全不加载。当存在1,000个无关技能时，已加载技能的召回率从73.6%下降到27.4%，零加载率从9.3%上升到51.6%；而在相同的技能库中进行显式选择则能保持73.9%的召回率。加载其他技能（包括黄金技能的合理替代项）的情况过于罕见，不足以解释这种性能下降。仅屏蔽无关技能的描述就能在很大程度上恢复技能加载；然而在元数据完整的情况下，明确要求智能体规划技能使用所产生的召回率仍低于预选择方式。这些发现指向了语义干扰问题。
tldr: 研究揭示了LLM智能体存在“技能路由崩溃”问题：随着无关技能增多，隐式路由导致相关技能加载召回率从73.6%骤降至27.4%，而显式选择可保持73.9%，表明技能元数据间的语义干扰是智能体技能库规模化的关键瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This study reveals "skill routing collapse" in LLM agents: implicit routing over skill metadata causes loaded-skill recall to drop from 73.6% to 27.4% with 1,000 irrelevant skills, while explicit selection retains 73.9%, identifying semantic interference among skill metadata as the key bottleneck for scaling agent skill libraries.
